title: KCP project_access_policy_change_confirm request (DESIGN.md §10.1, §11.6.1 project access-policy change family)
description: Mutation (meta required; §11.2: every state-changing operation requires meta). Confirms the exact prepared change: compare-and-swaps the Project revision; changing content/policy makes the intent stale (§10.1). Consumes the authorization decision receipt named by the §11.6.1 row (gap note KG17). Even a provable narrowing requires this typed confirm path (§10.1). Registry (shared_space_v1): surface external_client / authenticated project owner principal only (assurance: risk-required step-up). Surface and actor kind are registry-enforced, not schema-expressible (gap note KG14 for dual-surface ops).

decision_receipt_ref.description: The §11.6.1 row's authorization decision receipt for confirm (gap note KG17); recorded on the record as decision_receipt_ref (§10.1).

args.description: Exact prepared subject plus the decision receipt (gap note KG17); the proposal content is immutable after prepare — no proposed_* members exist on confirm.

commandMeta.description: Command.meta (§11.2). Required on every mutation; idempotency keys are scoped by authenticated actor, operation, and realm; expected_revision drives optimistic concurrency (mismatch is stale-revision).

ext.description: Extensions keyed by a reverse-domain namespace (§11.9); never interpreted as identity, authorization, budget, or policy.

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

protocolVersion.description: Negotiated KCP major.minor version; the initial protocol version is "0.1" (§11).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§11.8 rejects unsafe integers).

traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context traceparent header value; excluded from the idempotency request digest (§11.2).
